Sam: Heads-up — we need owners and a concrete plan for the token-cost heatmap/dashboard. Goal: one panel that surfaces cost per 1k tokens across model+route, plus breakdowns for cache and batch savings. Who can own end-to-end (runtime metrics -> telemetry -> dashboard)?
Maria: I can own the dashboard UX and product mapping, if someone from runtime can own metric names and query contract.
Noah: I can take runtime side. I'll propose metric set and labels.
Jin: I'll handle the infra/analytics ingestion (clickhouse schema + event joins).
Rachael: I can do cost auth / billing join and make sure 1k-token normalization is consistent with billing pipeline.
Sam: Awesome. Noah, can you sketch the metrics we need and the expected labels? Keep it minimal but sufficient for grouping.
Noah: Proposed metrics (runtime Prometheus/generic telemetry):
```
# counter - total tokens produced by request
tokens_output_total{model,route,deployment,region,quantized,customer_tier}
# gauge - kv cache hit ratio per route
kv_cache_hit_ratio{route,model,deployment}
# histogram - batch sizes seen by runtime
request_batch_size_histogram{route,model}
# counter - requests routed to fallback model
fallback_routed_total{from_model,to_model,route}
```
Labels to prioritize: model, route, deployment (dedicated/hosted/private), region, quantized (true/false).
Maria: For the UI heatmap we need a canonical 1k-token cost metric. Rachael — can you provide the join key so Jin can map runtime request_id -> billing tokens?
Rachael: Use request_id (UUID) in both runtime traces and billing events. Billing will surface billed_tokens and billed_cost_usd. Join on request_id during the hourly rollup. I'll add a billing flag billed_tokens_per_request.
Jin: For analytics table (clickhouse) I'll add a daily_rollup table with columns: date, model, route, deployment, region, tokens_sum, cost_usd_sum, kv_cache_hits, kv_cache_misses, batch_size_p50, batch_size_p95. That should allow computation of cost_per_1k = (cost_usd_sum / tokens_sum) * 1000.
Sam: Nice. What about cache/batch savings attribution? We need a way to estimate counterfactual cost if there were no cache or batching. Any lightweight approximations?
Noah: Runtime can emit two additional counters per request: tokens_raw_no_cache (what would have been emitted without cache) and tokens_no_batching (approx tokens if batching disabled) — these are noisy but useful for relative savings. Or simpler: emit kv_cache_evicted_tokens and batch_coalesced_tokens.
Maria: For the dashboard show columns: observed_cost_per_1k, estimated_cost_no_cache_per_1k, observed_cache_savings_pct, estimated_batch_savings_pct. Heatmap axes: rows=model family, cols=route (or product surface). Clicking a cell shows time series and raw counts.
Dee: ops-bot: @ops-bot created ticket INFR-452 for runtime metrics changes and linked to dash ticket PROD-689. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Ticket INFR-452 created by Dee. Assignees: Noah, Jin. Linked: PROD-689 (dash).
Jin: Quick PromQL examples for the dashboard queries (runtime panels):
```
# tokens per model per 5m
sum(rate(tokens_output_total[5m])) by (model)
# kv cache hit ratio per route (instant)
avg(kv_cache_hit_ratio) by (route)
# batch p95 size (derived from histogram)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_batch_size_histogram[5m])) by (le, route, model))
```
Rachael: For billing join, example ClickHouse pseudocode: 
```
SELECT model, route, sum(billed_tokens) as tokens_sum, sum(cost_usd) as cost_sum, sum(kv_cache_hits) as cache_hits
FROM request_rollup
WHERE date >= today()-7
GROUP BY model, route
```
Noah: Ownership: runtime metrics -> Noah. Ingest and rollups -> Jin. Billing join and cost correctness -> Rachael. Dash/UX -> Maria. Product validation -> Sam.
Maria: Timeline? Product wants a first-pass heatmap in staging for next week's dev review. That means runtime metric PRs by EOD Thu, ingestion changes by Fri, dashboard skeleton Monday. Fine?
Noah: PR for metrics by Thu morning. Will add feature flag and fallback metrics to avoid noise.
Jin: I'll prototype table schema today and add scripts to backfill last 30d.
Rachael: I'll expose a normalized cost-per-1k view from billing - needs approval from finance — pinging them now.
Sam: Thanks all. Action items saved in PROD-689. If anyone hits blockers ping here and @Sam. :eyes:
Maria: One UX note — add hover tooltip explaining how estimated savings are computed and link to a short doc. I'll draft the doc after we lock metric names.
Noah: Will post the PR diff here when ready.
Sam: Perfect. Closing loop for now.
